name: Serino
source:
[url=/c93219]Tachibana[/url]'s younger sister.
Losing both her parents since the day she was born, [url=/c93219]Tachibana[/url] is her one and only family. Serino loves her brother than anything else.
An obedient girl. Serino would put her ego aside in order to not cause any trouble to her brother (although, sometimes it did show on her face)
Loves sweets and conversation about plants and flowers.
